answer: The canyon is the sole registry and runs one batch auction each epoch. An inlet is a non-transferable, one-epoch execution lease; exactly 100 exist. A pearl is one fake identity, and every identity must hold an inlet. One clearing price applies: if displaced honest bids run one, two, three USDC and so on, ten clones cost ten USDC per lease, hence 100 USDC per epoch, not ten. Each added clone raises the price on the attacker’s whole position; wallets cannot split demand. Unsold capacity or auction capture defeats it.
